explanation: The supplied vulnerable/fixed pair for backend/app/api/routes/api_keys.py shows only the addition of an authorization dependency (RequirePermissionIfAuthEnabled) to the list_api_keys endpoint. That is a missing-authentication/authorization fix (CWE-862/CWE-306 class), not a cryptographic misuse fix. The CWE-321 hardcoded-key defect described in the advisory lives in backend/app/core/auth.py (the JWT signing secret), whose vulnerable/fixed code pair is not supplied. The candidate rule CRYPTO-007/CWE-321 is therefore not demonstrated by the supplied code, and the presented pair does not perform or correct any security-sensitive cryptographic operation.
note: Advisory references the hardcoded JWT secret at backend/app/core/auth.py#L28 and a separate fix commit c31f2968889c855f1ffacb700c2c9970deb2a6fb, but the supplied vuln/fix commits (572dbf3 -> a82f927) only patch route-level authentication on api_keys.py. The crypto-relevant code pair is missing from the candidate.
